propertySets.name: Pset_SensorTypeHumiditySensor
propertySets.definition: A device that senses or detects humidity. HISTORY: HumiditySensorSetPoint changed to SetPointHumidity. Range, accuracy and time constant deleted.

properties.name: SetPointHumidity
properties.definition: The humidity value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.
